source_identity.note: The evaluator records this verbatim as adapter_declared_source_identity and does NOT hash the external source tree recursively. This is the only place the HOT implementation's identity is bound to the result file.
source_identity.isa_requirement: AVX2 + BMI2 (Haswell or newer). This is a HARD constraint of the library: it cannot be built for x86-64-v2, and it is why the whole round is compiled at x86-64-v3 rather than at the level earlier rounds used.
source_identity.host_cpu_verified: Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX with avx2, bmi1, bmi2, adx -- checked before the ISA decision, not assumed
source_identity.value_type_constraint: HOT requires its value type to fit in a pointer (its interface static-asserts this), so the trie stores pointers to adapter-owned pair records.
source_identity.key_type_constraint: HOT addresses keys as NUL-terminated const char*, so a key containing NUL cannot be represented and is declared unsupported.
